detail.body:
## What does this PR do?
Restores publication of the released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron-3.5 Super Text-only guides, reversing the publication restrictions introduced by #6380.

## Changelog
- Restore both guides in Sphinx and nightly Fern navigation and Nemotron indexes.
- Remove the temporary redirects and Sphinx exclusions that hid the guides.
- Remove catalog filtering and regenerate Supported Models from the current cards.
- Add regression coverage for both guides, navigation, catalog links, exclusions, and redirect absence.
- Preserve guide content, verification cards, model code, and current main changes.

## GitHub Actions CI
Validation completed locally:
- 24 focused model-verification catalog tests passed.
- Catalog generator --check passed.
- All-file pre-commit passed using an isolated pre-commit environment; normal project resolution is blocked by the uninitialized MCore submodule.
- Fern 5.40.0 check: zero errors, one warning.
- git diff --check passed; independent full-diff review found no actionable issues.

Tests used an isolated pytest/PyYAML environment with --confcutdir=tests/unit_tests/doc_consistency to avoid unrelated GPU fixtures. No model execution or verification reruns are required for this docs-only restoration. Live site deployment is not verified locally.

## Before your PR is Ready for review
- [x] Read and followed contributor guidelines.
- [x] Updated regression tests.
- [x] Updated documentation.
- [ ] Affects optional installed components (not applicable).

## Additional Information
Reverses #6380 while retaining subsequent main-branch changes.
